$comment: E-mail contract between backend and SMTP server (docs/02_specification.md section 9). Placeholders in {braces} are filled by the backend; amounts with two decimals and the suffix ' EUR'. Every line is plain text; no HTML.
trigger: one message per stored registration, after the database commit (AC-001-04)
bodyLines: your registration for the conference has been received.

placeholderRules.workshopTitle: title from APP_WORKSHOPS for the selected id, or 'none' when no workshop is selected
placeholderRules.netFee: stored net fee, two decimals, '.' as decimal separator

safety: user input appears only in the body and in the To address (SR-05)
the To address is parsed with InternetAddress; validation rejects control characters, so no CR/LF can reach a header
the Subject contains only fixed text and the system-generated registration number
no HTML part, so no markup can be injected
failure: registration stays stored, API still answers 201, log line with the registration number and exception class only, no retry (D-09)
